title: urgencias-core: reference pipeline for Chilean emergency department analytics, forecasting, and simulation
description: Open-source Python package that turns visit-level emergency department (ED) records into operational decision support: a visits-to-hourly-occupancy transform, Chilean calendar features, a uniform quantile Forecaster interface (seasonal-naive, statsforecast, LightGBM), an evaluation harness with pinball-loss scoring, an empirical length-of-stay Monte Carlo occupancy simulator, a client for the public DEIS MINSAL Atenciones de Urgencia dataset, and a minimal reference dashboard. Open foundation of Eunosia.
